sonnet.problem: Card 1 states as fact that "A whole group speaks to one person." Verses 1-4 only say "you," and the "we" does not appear until verse 5. The text does not say who is speaking or who is being spoken to. The later cards repeat this framing as "the group" and "this person."
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
